architectureDecisions: ProductHistoryHead is the sole product-completeness/currentness cursor for one product/root intent. It is a CAS head {generation, commitRef, historyDigest}; each immutable ProductHistoryCommit binds its predecessor plus the complete ordered closure-relevant transition set admitted at that generation.

Closure-relevant transitions are accepted product-semantic changes only: SemanticClaim/CrossDomainObligation currentness from Integration C, accepted DeploymentRelease/QualityAcceptance currentness from Integration E/F, accepted product artifact revisions, and canonical acceptance-policy/waiver revisions. ExecutionPolicy, ExecutionStrategy, attempt/runtime and scheduler/activation changes are excluded unless they change accepted product semantic lineage.

BB-055 may research BB-052 and BB-054 READY plans as PLANNED_DEPENDENCY contracts. WORKER remains dependency-gated and must bind the delivered C and E/F source/truth after BB-054 is DONE; planned files are never treated as current authority.

Every closure-relevant publisher participates in one project-scoped ProductHistory mutation guard. The authoritative currentness mutation and ProductHistoryHead advancement occur inside the same guarded window; ProductStateProjection and closure currentness checks use the same guard so no stable projection can observe a newer closure-relevant head behind an older ProductHistoryHead.

Crash recovery is fail-closed. ProductHistory commits preserve exact authority-head observations; if a fresh process detects a closure-relevant authority head not committed by the current history head, projection returns RECOVERY_REQUIRED/NOT_READY and reconcileProductHistory deterministically appends the missing canonical transition before readiness can be exposed.

ProductHistoryCommit is append-only evidence, not a mutable snapshot. historyDigest is deterministic from predecessor digest plus normalized transition identity; generation must advance by exactly one and the chain is revalidated on fresh reconstruction.

ProductAcceptanceAuthority is separate canonical authority: immutable policy/waiver artifacts plus a CAS current head. The trusted resolver derives the full applicable waiver set; callers cannot provide a convenient waiver subset. ProductProjectionSubject pins exact history head generation/digest plus acceptance-policy head revision/ref and waiverSetDigest.

ProductStateProjection is a deterministic disposable reduction over one ProductProjectionSubject. It resolves the complete history chain and canonical acceptance authority, computes current active claims/obligations/releases/quality facts, unresolved blocking obligations and blockers, and emits ELIGIBLE_FOR_CLOSURE only when every required current condition is satisfied.

The projection builder accepts productId/root intent only; it has no API for caller-selected claimRefs, obligationRefs, qualityRefs or waiverRefs. Completeness comes from canonical history/authority traversal, not caller enumeration.

ProductOutcomeClaim is immutable historical closure evidence bound to exact projectionRef/projectionDigest/ProductProjectionSubject and supporting evidence refs. It is stored separately from ProductHistory so creating a claim does not invalidate its own readiness basis.

Closure publication acquires the same product-history mutation guard plus acceptance-authority currentness guard, re-resolves the exact projection subject immediately before commit, requires ELIGIBLE_FOR_CLOSURE, stores ProductOutcomeClaim and optionally advances a latest-outcome pointer. Any history/policy/waiver drift fails with no current closure.

A historical ProductOutcomeClaim is current only by revalidation: currentOutcome resolves the current ProductProjectionSubject and compares it to the claim subject. Later accepted Backend/FE/QA/obligation/policy transitions retain the old claim artifact but make it non-current until a fresh eligible projection is closed.

Historical SemanticClaim, CrossDomainObligation, ProductHistoryTransition/Commit, acceptance-policy/waiver artifacts, ProductStateProjection and ProductOutcomeClaim are immutable. Correction is represented by a new authoritative transition/head advance; in-place overwrite conflicts fail closed.
implementationSlices: G1 — Canonical product history [AC-1, AC-2, AC-5, AC-7, AC-8, INV-1, INV-2, INV-4]: implement ProductHistoryTransition/Commit plus createProductHistoryController({artifactStore,headStore,mutationGuard,authorityReaders}) in product-history.js. Each commit binds previous generation/digest and exact canonical authority-head observations. Integrate C semantic currentness and E/F release/quality publication through the project mutation guard; execution-policy/strategy changes do not append history. Verify product-history + dependency regressions.

G2 — Crash-safe completeness reconciliation [AC-5, INV-4, INV-8]: implement reconcileProductHistory(projectId) that compares the current history commit observations with every registered closure-relevant authority head. Missing/newer canonical authority transitions force RECOVERY_REQUIRED and are deterministically appended from immutable canonical refs before projection can become eligible. Verify kill/restart points in product-history-recovery.

G3 — Canonical acceptance authority [AC-6, INV-6, AC-8]: in product-acceptance-policy.js persist immutable ProductAcceptancePolicy/ProductWaiver artifacts behind a CAS ProductAcceptanceAuthorityHead. resolveCurrent(productId) returns exact policy ref/head revision plus the complete applicable waiver set and waiverSetDigest; no caller subset API. Historical artifacts are immutable. Verify product-state-projection + product-revalidation.

G4 — Deterministic ProductStateProjection [AC-1, AC-2, AC-4, AC-5, AC-6, INV-1, INV-2, INV-3, INV-6]: implement createProductStateProjectionBuilder({productHistory,acceptanceAuthority,artifactResolvers}). build({productId,rootIntentRef}) acquires the product guard, resolves one ProductProjectionSubject, traverses/validates the exact ProductHistory chain, derives complete current active claims/obligations/releases/quality facts and unresolved blockers, and stores a content-addressed projection. The API accepts no selected claim/obligation/waiver refs. Verify omission resistance and deterministic rebuild in product-state-projection.

G5 — Currentness-fenced closure [AC-3, AC-6, INV-5, INV-6]: in product-closure.js implement createProductClosureController({projectionBuilder,productHistory,acceptanceAuthority,artifactStore,outcomeHeadStore}). close({projectionRef}) re-resolves the projection, acquires exact history+acceptance guards, rechecks ProductProjectionSubject and ELIGIBLE_FOR_CLOSURE immediately before immutable ProductOutcomeClaim publication. Drift produces no current closure. Verify pre-start and barrier-controlled races in product-closure-race.

G6 — Historical claim/current outcome semantics [AC-7, AC-9, INV-5, INV-7]: currentOutcome({productId}) resolves the latest ProductOutcomeClaim but returns current only when its exact ProductProjectionSubject equals the current history/policy/waiver subject and current projection remains eligible. A newer accepted product transition makes old closure historical; an ExecutionStrategy/ExecutionPolicy-only change leaves history subject unchanged. Verify product-revalidation.

G7 — Fresh-process end-to-end completeness proof [AC-1..AC-9, INV-1..INV-8]: export stores/controllers from index.js and use durable JSON immutable/CAS stores. product-completeness-chain reconstructs from disk, proves omitted rejected claim/obligation cannot be hidden, closes an eligible subject, advances product history and policy independently, proves historical claim retention/non-currentness, rebuilds identical projections for identical pinned subjects, and rejects in-place artifact mutation.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Omitting a current QUALITY_REJECTED claim from caller input cannot make the product eligible; the builder derives it from canonical history and returns NOT_READY.
evidenceRequired: Builder derives current QUALITY_REJECTED from canonical history even when caller supplies no claim refs; readiness is NOT_READY.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Omitting a current blocking obligation from caller input cannot make the product eligible; the builder derives the obligation and returns NOT_READY.
evidenceRequired: Builder derives every current blocking obligation from canonical history/lineage; caller omission cannot remove blocker.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A projection built at history head Hn cannot authorize closure after a closure-relevant Hn+1 transition; the closure currentness recheck rejects the stale basis.
evidenceRequired: Projection at Hn is rejected after guarded Hn+1 transition before closure commit.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Deleting any cached ProductStateProjection and rebuilding from the same pinned subject yields identical readiness, active-set identity and blockers.
evidenceRequired: Delete cached projection, rebuild exact pinned subject, compare readiness, active-set digest and blockers byte-for-byte.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Restarting a fresh process can reconstruct the same current product subject and projection from durable history/policy refs without prior conversation state.
evidenceRequired: Fresh process reconstructs canonical history head/chain and identical projection from durable stores; uncommitted authority drift is fail-closed then reconciled.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Changing acceptance-policy revision while product history is unchanged makes the old projection subject non-current and requires deterministic re-evaluation.
evidenceRequired: Acceptance policy/waiver authority revision changes ProductProjectionSubject and invalidates old projection currentness.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Publishing a new accepted Backend or other closure-relevant product revision after closure retains the old ProductOutcomeClaim historically but makes current readiness re-evaluate under the newer history head.
evidenceRequired: New accepted product revision advances history, preserves old ProductOutcomeClaim artifact, and makes it non-current pending rebuild/reclosure.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Attempted in-place mutation of an historical claim, obligation, history commit or ProductOutcomeClaim is rejected; correction occurs through new immutable transitions.
evidenceRequired: Immutable artifact conflict is rejected for claim/obligation/history/policy/outcome; correction uses new immutable transition/head revision.
